message:
We had one of those unexpected little storms roll through last week. You know, the kind that catches everyone off guard? Well, as the wind howled and the rain poured, we found ourselves cozying up in our living room, surrounded by our go-bags and a stash of snacks that we had packed just in case. 

In that moment, I couldn’t help but feel a little smug, thinking back to the conversations we’d had about being prepared. It was a reminder of how much peace of mind comes from being ready, even for the surprises life throws our way. 

Have you had a moment like that lately? 😊
